rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides access to the UK Scouts Policy, Organisation and Rules (POR) document through automated PDF processing and text search. Downloads the latest POR PDF from the official Scouts website, extracts and caches text content using PyMuPDF, and exposes a search tool that performs case-insensitive queries across all pages. Returns matching pages with snippets and PDF page numbers for Scout leaders, volunteers, and administrators who need quick access to specific policies, procedures, or organizational rules.
